protocol.name: Generic Biondi-style broad-overlap sub-aperture pixel-tracking tomography
canonical_pipeline: COMMON CORE: Reference/Offset complex sub-apertures R_k,O_k
COMMON CORE: 32x32 complex u-PCC target registration -> Y_vector
COMMON CORE: two-arc robust nuisance correction -> G_arc_vector
BRANCH A: full ordered K50 modal characterization m=1..24; all W25 windows enter real two-component depth focus
BRANCH B: per-W25 ordered ellipse fit m=1..6; only accepted W25 windows enter the same real two-component depth focus
protocol.epistemic_status: Registration vectors are image-registration observables. Absolute/candidate depth remains conditional on the declared wavelength/velocity model and on the physical validity of the vector history. Kz computation, state-vector geometry, and W=25 numerical self-consistency have passed independent audits; vector fidelity and nuisance/model mismatch remain live.

branch_B_selective_1_6.label: selective low-order ellipse branch
branch_B_selective_1_6.modal_support: each contiguous W25 q_arc family independently
branch_B_selective_1_6.depth_support_rule: only W25 families passing the ellipse gate
branch_B_selective_1_6.status: versioned selective alternative; not a replacement for Branch A

registration.pairing_rule: register only Reference_k against Offset_k at same k

arc_operator.side_aggregation: 2D geometric median over independent registration vectors

retired_control.name: two_focal_flank_mean
retired_control.description: one + flank and one - flank registration near +/-40 px, averaged

branch_B_selective_1_6.support: each contiguous W25 family; local n=0..24
branch_B_selective_1_6.sampling_rationale: W/m >= approximately 4 vectors per circuit; with W=25 this gives m<=6

kz_geometry.Bperp_definition: Bperp_k = B_k dot e_A; same-orbit virtual baseline projected perpendicular to LOS
kz_geometry.do_not_use_as_Bperp: tiny cross-orbit e_LOS x e_A component

strengthening_criteria: support in nearby overlapping W25 windows

W50_control.interpretation: tests coherence across the full aperture; failure does not veto a W25 candidate

branch_rules.branch_A_full_1_24: S_W25(x,z)=max over all 26 contiguous W25 windows of adjusted_R2(x,z,w)
branch_rules.branch_B_selective_1_6: S_gate(x,z)=max over ellipse-gate-accepted W25 windows only; blank/NaN if none pass

depth_focus.z0_branch_B_diagnostic: For accepted W25 families, score z=0 separately as a constant-vector fit because ordinary steering is rank-deficient at z=0.

completed.result: Injected ideal trajectories recovered at injected depth; no intrinsic superlinear depth drift.
completed.rules_out: W25 solver numerical drift as primary cause.

completed.audit: Independent Kz reconstruction from state vectors
completed.result: 14950 entries; max abs Kz difference about 4.82e-7 rad/m; median relative error about 8.56e-7; correlation 1.0; steering entries reproduce to ~1e-5 scale at 34 m.
completed.rules_out: Coding/geometry error in current Bperp, range, theta, or Kz implementation.

completed.result: Realistic uncertainty far too small to explain observed depth stretch.
completed.rules_out: Ordinary state-vector error as primary cause.

completed.audit: Bperp definition against Biondi geometry figure
completed.result: Saved Bperp matches same-orbit LOS-orthogonal along-aperture component.
completed.rules_out: Mistaken cross-orbit interpretation as a reason to reject current synthetic baseline.

completed.audit: Raw Y vs retired two-flank q_old
completed.result: Removing old flank correction does not remove deep overfocus.
completed.rules_out: Old two-focal-flank correction as sole cause.

completed.result: Arc correction is smaller and q_arc stays closer to raw Y, but deep families remain displaced.
completed.rules_out: Local flank over-correction as sole cause; vector/forward-model mismatch remains live.

completed.result: No universal unchanged q trajectory across sites; old local flank mean can increase variance.
completed.rules_out: One universal additive common-mode trajectory applicable everywhere.

completed.result: W25 support remains near the known shaft-depth anchor under q_old and raw Y.
completed.status: Consistency only; not independent absolute-depth validation because lambda was calibrated there.

summary_ruled_out_as_primary_cause: retired two-focal-flank correction as sole cause
